title: goinspire.xyz
tagline: Inspire and motivate positive actions within group chats with onchain AI-driven experiences
description:
goinspire.xyz is a platform where AI-driven inspirational experiences in group chats encourage people to take positive actions.

Users can set up experiences where AI characters join the conversation, each playing a specific role to guide the discussion towards a positive outcome. The platform allows for the strategic use of public information, subtly influencing decisions while maintaining privacy. These experiences can be used in various scenarios, such as motivating someone to adopt a new habit or supporting community efforts.

The project aims to make it easier for users to inspire actions naturally and realistically by leveraging onchain AI-driven interactions.
how_its_made:
With goinspire.xyz, users start by visiting the website to create an onchain inspirational experience. They specify the desired positive action, such as making a donation or adopting a new habit, identify the person they want to inspire, and outline the details of the group chat scenario. Once this information is submitted, the platform uses XMTP to securely set up the group chat.

After setting up the chat, the platform provides a link to invite the target person. When the target joins the group chat, a multi-agent system powered by Galadriel begins its work. These AI agents use contextual information, dynamically adjusting their responses to guide the conversation toward the desired positive outcome.

Finally, when the onchain inspiration experience is finished, users can create their "Proof of Inspiration" by verifying that the action was actually made onchain and receive an attestation of doing so. This will help them improve their Leaderboard ranking showing who was the person who inspired the most people.
